newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 24.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the U.S. Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 15.49 points to 6,804.79, with the long bond yield at 6.96 percent.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index fell 13.05 points to 1,212.94 on continuing fears of the impact of an expected interest rate hike in the U.S. on Tuesday.
* Malaysian Resources Corporation Bhd and two of its associate companies are expected to announce a major restructuring plan later on Monday.
